evidence: bare_number_card: seg3:mid–seg4:end are two teal circles with '127%' printed in them and nothing else. Nothing demonstrates the number.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start–end and the whole of seg4 show two identical circles, both labelled 'Billionaire wealth' and both reading '127%', while the narration says the S&P 500 grew 195 percent. The S&P figure never appears on screen.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine was bound to one series twice. The second entity (the S&P 500, 195%) was lost, so the scene contradicts its own claim and draws two equal shapes.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show billionaire wealth +127% against the S&P 500 +195% as two clearly different sizes, with the stock pile visibly bigger. Label each correctly, and have Data physically pour or stack into the S&P side so the stocks outgrowing the billionaires is the picture.
